post.title: Nested loops cause slow O(N squared) complexity on subarray problems. | Sliding Window
post.subtitle:
Are you still solving subarray problems with nested loops? That's O(N squared) complexity, making your code slow and inefficient for large inputs! 🛠️

Learn how to master Sliding Window Technique Explained Simply in this quick breakdown.

📖 Read the full guide here:
https://www.abstractalgorithms.dev/

In this Short:
- Nested loops cause slow O(N squared) complexity on subarray problems.
- A window slides across the array, adding the new and dropping the old.
- Adjust left and right pointers to dynamically resize the window.
- Use it to find contiguous subarrays or substrings efficiently.
- Full guide in description. Subscribe for more software engineering guides!
